name: Shikigi Yuuri
source:
"I'm glad I got this! My teaching license!"

He is an temporary faculty teacher caught up in this story. His occupation selection is blank, but this is not a mistake, as this field only indicates one's occupation and "Role" in the game world. Of course, Shikigi Yuuri is the only one who is able to fall into the game world in the flesh. He does not have a "Role". So what can he accomplish in XR?
That is the key question to this story.
Having no role or occupation given to you by the game lets you have complete freedom!
If he has no role, he has no role. It's up to where his feelings may take him.

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: Human
Height: 175 cm
Occupation: －－－
